claims: AP® Lang score is short for AP® English Language and Composition score, in which you can get a score from 1 to 5.
Many colleges give credit or placement depending on the score you obtained, where 1 is no recommendation, and 5 is extremely well qualified.
For 2025, the AP® Lang score distribution was as shown in the table below.
The mean score was 3.2, which was exceptionally high compared to previous years, when it was about 2.8-2.9.

AP® Lang score Percentage of students 5 13.4% 4 28% 3 32.8% 2 16.1% 1 9.7% 💡 Speaking of statistical distributions, be sure to check the normal distribution calculator or binomial distribution calculator.
The AP® Lang exam is scored in the following way: Count the points in 45 multiple-choice questions — 45% of the score.
Count the points in the three essays — 55% of the score.
This is converted to an AP scale (1-5) using the AP® Lang score breakdown table.
Check the AP® Lang score breakdown table to find your final score (1-5).
It is equivalent to a B-, C+, or C grade, and many colleges will place you for a 3.
